evidenceBoundary: A browser renders the current SkillEditor and MarkdownEditor components against a deterministic in-memory window.ryu.skills fixture. Tests prove form state, toolbar output, save/retry/readback, snapshot/diff/restore calls, and visible failure recovery. The host-only Use with agents flow is covered only through its bridge request; actual Core Git history, filesystem writes, agent target selection/distribution, live model/provider effects, and branch/delete operations are not exercised. The current VersionHistory UI exposes Diff and Restore but has no branch or delete controls.
